4888565.sourceDescription: Dress your tree in rich red this year with a pack of 49 shatterproof baubles that'll bring the glamour without the worry. They're made from polystyrene so if one takes a tumble, there's no drama, no broken parts to sweep up. Just easy festive decorating you can relax into. Each bauble comes pre-threaded with gold cord, so you can hang them straight from the box. No fiddly threading, no hunting for hooks. You've got 49 to play with, so there's plenty to fill out a tree or scatter across a few smaller ones. They're designed for indoor use, adding warmth and shine wherever you need a splash of Christmas colour. . 49 decorations included.; Contains gold pre-threaded baubles.; Made from polystyrene.; Shatterproof.; Suitable for indoor usage.

The variety means every angle looks different, adding depth and visual interest from top to bottom. Made from plastic, they're designed to withstand the bustle of the festive season without breakage. ydz4jc1j.baseName: Walplus 530 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
ydz4jc1j.variantName: Walplus 530 Branch Tips Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - Green - 150 cm
ydz4jc1j.sourceDescription: This beautiful artificial hinged Christmas tree is very lifelike in its shape and appearance and is meant to create just the right atmosphere for this Christmas. Hinged construction: The Christmas tree has a hinged construction, so the branches will automatically fold down at the right angle. This will make it much easier to put up the tree in the perfect shape and will save you time as well.Lifelike tips: The Christmas decoration has realistic PVC tips, making the tree lifelike in its shape and appearance.Sturdy stand: The metal stand provides your artificial Christmas tree with optimal sturdiness and stability.Economical choice: You can reuse the Xmas tree every year, which is a cost-effective option compared to getting a real tree. Good to know:We recommend setting aside 30-45 minutes after assembly to properly shape the tree by peeling back the branches and pulling the tips apart to give the branches a more full-bodied look. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC (polyvinylchloride), metal Total height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 80 cm Stand size: 35 x 13 cm (W x H) Hinged construction With 530 PVC tips Suitable for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery contains: 1 x Artificial hinged Christmas tree 1 x Stand • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

pnwcc45q.baseName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
pnwcc45q.variantName: Christmas Tree World 10ft Pre-Lit Wildhorn Pine Half - Warm White Lights
pnwcc45q.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 10ft Pre-lit Wildhorn Pine Half Tree. Its half-tree design combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 530 multi-function warm white LED lights and a generous front profile. Measuring 155cm wide and 100cm deep, it sits neatly against a wall or in a corner, leaving more room for your Christmas celebrations. Broad lower branches and a classic, tapered shape create a full front display in rooms where floor space is limited. Short-cut pine needle outer branches and inner PVC tips add depth and fullness. Natural green shades and subtle brown detailing create a lovely backdrop for decorations. The fitted warm white LEDs highlight the foliage, with multiple lighting effects to suit your festive display. The tree comes in five sections, with flexible branches for easy shaping and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. For indoor use, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and 1 year on lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Product Features • Size: 10ft • Pre-lit: 530 multi-function warm white LED lights • Number of branch tips: 2,106 • Foliage: Realistic pine needle outer branches with traditional PVC tips towards the centre for added fullness • Foliage colour: Natural green • Tree dimensions: 155cm wide × 100cm deep • Design: Half tree for positioning against a wall or in a corner • Construction: Attached flexible branches for easy positioning and shaping • Assembly: Five tree sections • Base: Metal stand measuring 100cm in diameter • Includes gloves to wear during assembly • Indoor use only • Guarantee: 10 years on foliage and branches, plus 1 year on the lights • Supplied in two cartons • Carton 1: 126cm × 30cm × 32cm; weight: 12.70kg • Carton 2: 120cm × 27cm × 29cm; weight: 11.75kg • Combined carton weight: 24.45kg • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. Read the operating instructions before use. Keep away from heat sources. Christmas Tree World, Unit 3, Enfield Industrial Estate, Enfield Street, Wigan, Greater Manchester, WN5 8DB, United Kingdom
